exact: trans-Golgi-derived vesicle fusion with medial-Golgi cisterna membrane

definition: The joining of the lipid bilayer membrane around a trans-Golgi-derived vesicle to the lipid bilayer membrane around the medial-Golgi cisterna. Such vesicles include COPI-coated transport vesicles involved in retrograde transport.
label: trans-Golgi-derived vesicle fusion with Golgi medial cisterna membrane
